sentences.text: Made by Aalto Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-17 under the industry code 73112, other activities of advertising agencies.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-17, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-21.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a word that can mean waves in Finnish, but the registered industry is advertising.
